assumptions.record_model: Beta(2,2) shrinkage of the season win rate, then log5 between the two shrunk rates. No home-field term is added because no home-split edge is measured here.
assumptions.nhl_winner: Binary market: wins include overtime and shootout wins; losses include regulation, overtime and shootout losses.
assumptions.nhl_goal_model: Independent Poisson goals per side. Each side's rate averages its own goals-for per game and the opponent's goals-against per game. Regulation-goal approximation: overtime and shootout goals are not separate events in the grid.
assumptions.mlb_run_model: Independent Poisson runs per side, conditioned on the game not finishing tied. Rates average own runs scored per game and opponent runs allowed per game from the final regular-season table. Postseason personnel, starting pitchers, bullpens, parks and travel are not modelled.
assumptions.basketball_handicap: Margins are modelled as Normal with an ASSUMED standard deviation of 12.0 points; the mean is set so that the model's win probability is reproduced. 12.0 is an assumption, not a measured league constant, and basketball handicap rows are capped below High for that reason.
assumptions.basketball_totals: Expected total is the sum of the two sides' expected points, where a side's expectation averages its own points per game and the opponent's points allowed per game as quoted by the official preview. Totals are only originated when BOTH averages are published.
assumptions.handicaps: Only half-point lines are originated, so every handicap or total settles without a push. Whole-number lines are deliberately not offered.
assumptions.high_rule: The brief asks for selections above a 70% chance whose price is inside -250..+10000. American -250 is decimal 1.40, i.e. 71.4286%. A fair price above 70% is therefore at most 1.4286 decimal, so the two rules only intersect on 70.0000% < p <= 71.4286%. High is issued only inside that intersection, with verified inputs on both sides and a written prediction.
